body:
The acceptance test `test_regression_issue_703` expects payment to be applied to INV-000301 (due 2024-06-01) before INV-000300 (due 2024-05-15), which contradicts the 'oldest due first' requirement and conflicts with `test_oldest_first` in the same file. 

Invoice due dates:
- INV-000300: 2024-04-15 + 30 = 2024-05-15 (oldest)
